comment: The ONE Auto-Pigeon Extractor revision every AUCOM release bundles. Reviewed like code: changing it changes what users run. Never a branch, a tag or a release URL - a full commit SHA, checked out exactly by .github/workflows/release.yml. The extractor's embedded AULIBS data names the AULIBS commit it was synced from, and the workflow checks that commit of aulibs_repository out to build it against.
